title: Inter-coder reliability of the weather-input-timing audit
design: independent agent coders per paper; several papers were coded more than once because runs were retried after session limits, giving a genuine multi-coder subset

yes_vs_not_yes.why_this_is_the_binding_statistic: every reported rate is a share of papers coded Yes, so a disagreement that does not cross the Yes boundary cannot move any rate in the paper
